   **Pricing and paywall.**

      Review window: Sep 1, 2026 - Sep 5, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _silna salim_, Sep 5, 2026, 1/5: "The automatic renewal of my subscription has occurred, and I am currently unable to cancel it. This service does not align with my fitness preferences and has proven to be entirely unhelpful. A monthly payment has been automatically debited from my account. I cancelled your service within five minutes of the renewal. I require a full refund for this charge."
            2. _Kay Wilkins_, Sep 5, 2026, 2/5: "I canceled my subscription and deleted the app. I was charged again today. No warning. I want my money refunded."
            3. _Akash Mishra_, Sep 3, 2026, 4/5: "However, the customer service and help desk experience has fallen short of the high standards set by the app itself. When encountering technical questions, subscription management concerns, or account-specific dashboard issues, getting a clear, timely, and effective resolution can be frustrating. Often, responses feel slow or lack the specific context needed to resolve account-related hurdles smoothly."
